snippet.title: Elden Ring Seamless Coop Trailer
snippet.description:
An Elden Ring Coop mod made by LukeYui (author of Sekiro coop mod) where you can explore The Land Between with your friends.

Your world can joins up to 6 players (included host) on your journey but beware, malicious wanderers might invade your world, be ready for what ahead.

Seamless Coop have PvP, Friendly Fire, PvP Team depend on what your enjoy!

Ah yes, you can summon spirit ashes to help you on your fights, use it wisely!
______________________
Special thanks to:
Kanna - Rewdy - matierre - Dalvik - InuNorii - Sydjex -  MircoMCD - Grum - Pepper - Tehara
for helping me recording scenes
______________________
